what: The grade job split into stages, each a set of lines of r15-grade-jobs.sh (the job mkparts.sh splits into the five parts), with what each stage costs. A stage is the unit the screen caches, shards and estimates.
timings: g15_minutes: the stage's wall-clock minutes on one arm, from the stage marks in programme/results/ptv20/box-g15/parts/*/jobs.log (registration/fifteenth f52c9f79): c8g.16xlarge (64 vCPU), exam seeds, SKIP_GATE. The box and r7 marks cover several tools; their split is in the note. cores_per_arm: the cores one arm keeps busy, from the worker counts in the stage lines, capped at 64.

not_staged.impact (158-162): impact_curve.py on pt-v20 itself: feeds no row (C9 is read from the mc stage's per-arm shim)
not_staged.scenarios (163-175): skipped by GRID=1 on every screen and grade

box.boot_note: launch to first stage on g15: 13:01:38 to 13:03:28 with SKIP_GATE (dnf, rustup, clone, a 46-52 s release build, two known-answer runs). Without SKIP_GATE the pytest and cargo gate adds about 7 minutes (programme/results/*/run.log: preflight to first stage 8.3-9.2 min on 18 gated runs, 1.0-1.2 min on 10 SKIP_GATE runs). v21v2 (wheel built on the box, SKIP_GATE): launch 14:50:16, screen start 14:51:59, 1.7 min.

ptv21.note: ptv21.py measure --parts free: one 21-year free history per seed with every name's first-tick open and close (ON1, G1, G1c, U1-U4, O1-O4, SK1, SK2). Not a grade-job stage. Minutes are an estimate from the desk: one R20M history of 3 years took 27 s, so 21 years about 2.5 to 3 min; 30 seeds on 90 workers are one wave.

ptv22fut.note: futrows.py run (design ptv22/futures-rows 56358419, the reader merged here): ptv22.run_free per seed, reduced at once to each row's pieces (pieces-<seed>.json) and a slim series (diag-<seed>.npz), 270 x 21 years. Reads the registered line as written, no --switches (draft, 'The plan'). Minutes: on v22reads19N futrows on the full 194-dial line took 5.4 min for 8 seeds (one wave), so 270 on 64 workers about 5 waves.

ptv22chain.note: ptv22.py measure --parts chain: the index chain and every name's strips at each close, 270 x 21 years (CRITERIA-pt-v22.md: the names' chain rows read 270 at the grade), then ptv22_pieces.py writes chain-<seed>.pkl.gz beside the histories (what ptv22_passprob.py reads). The index surface's SV and OB rows come out of the same histories and are reported, not graded, while ptv22idx is off. Minutes: v22reads19N, 96 histories in 13.1 min (two waves), so 270 about 5 waves.

ptv22names.note: ptv22.py measure --parts names: the single-name option accounts, the rules and the pin trials (MG3, XD5, AX1, AX2; ptv22traded.run_names), 270 x 21 years. Minutes: v22reads19N, 270 histories in 37.4 min.

script: echo "=== ptv22traded traded, metaorder and push  $(date -u +%H:%M:%S)"
ptv22traded.note: ptv22.py measure --parts traded on PTV22_SEEDS (MG2, XD1 with the tape allowance, XD2) and --parts metaorder,push on PTV22_MP_SEEDS (IF4, XD3), 21 years, then tpieces.py. Minutes: an estimate. v22reads19N ran free, metaorder, push and traded on the line without the options dials in 30.9 min; on the full line the draft expects more. The dry run measures it.

script: echo "=== ptv22idx: the arm must list index options (switched-off stage)"
ptv22idx.note: SWITCHED OFF in v22 (draft item 11). Index options are measured by ptv22chain (the index chain: SV, OB) and ptv22names (the index parity trades: XD4) whenever the arm lists them, so turning them on is "enabled": true here and options_index_listed 1 on the arm: no new measuring code. This stage measures nothing: it refuses an arm that does not list them. On the desk, ptv22_switch.py rows checks the parts recorded the rows and grades them only when the stage is on.

script: echo "=== ptv22vix: the arm must list the VIX future (switched-off stage)"
ptv22vix.note: SWITCHED OFF in v22 (draft item 11). The VIX futures curve is measured by ptv22fut (VF1-VF8) and the VIX rules and push by ptv22traded whenever the arm lists the VIX future, so turning it on is "enabled": true here and futures_vix_listed 1 (with its live dials) on the arm. This stage measures nothing: it refuses an arm that does not list them. On the desk, ptv22_switch.py rows checks the parts recorded the rows and grades them only when the stage is on.

channels_note: The channels a stage opens: the union over its tools. Traded tools (tf.evaluate agents, metaorders, round trips, the World's agents) open order_flow and agent_book; tools that read the book's quotes or depth open agent_book; the arrival-order tools open arrival. A row reached through a channel is re-measured only on its stages that open that channel; its other stages are read from the baseline.
floors: floor_minutes_n10: the longest of the two arms' minutes for the stage on box v21v2 (2026-10-04, c8g.16xlarge, two arms, 10 seeds per list, one shard at a time). A stage on a few seeds takes one wave of its longest task however few seeds it has, which the core-minute model cannot see; with shards run one at a time a shard takes at least this long. Stages v21v2 did not run (regr, edgeaudit, aopool, stab, r7pre) have no floor. stab and ptv21: box s1a1 (2026-10-04), 10.66 and 2.89 minutes; stab's 12 histories of 100 years do not shrink with the seed count. edgeaudit and regr: g15 (one arm, its own box), 51.65 and 30.40 minutes; neither shrinks below its own wall time. The ptv22 stages: one wave of their longest history on box v22reads19N (2026-10-26, c8g.16xlarge, R22-reg19n at 64 workers), until the dry run measures them.
graded_scenarios_note: sf, recession and c4 run their tools through graded_scenarios.py, so the packaged scenarios they load are the ones the pt-v20 grade's engine (caaa4c6e) packaged and the rows were banded on, not the build's own. On ptv21/base the packaged files are dev's, which hold the corporate yield's level and read SF5 at 0.00.
outputs_note: outputs: files a finished shard must hold (globs, {ARM} the arm). A shard missing one is failed and never cached: a tool that crashes inside a stage leaves the job's exit status 0 (a pool crash in desk_sf on the desk, 2026-10-04). edgeaudit names files, not edge-{ARM}/*: edgegen_arm.py makes edge-{ARM}/gen and /eval before it reads its seeds, so a run whose three tools all crashed matched the folder glob and was cached as measured (dry run g19dry1, 2026-10-26).
switches_note: A stage with "enabled": false is in the job but off: screen.py plans leave it out and the desk does not grade its rows. "requires_dials": the arm must set these, or the stage refuses to run. In v22 ptv22idx and ptv22vix are off (draft item 11).
